seo.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about Centrifungal mushroom grow logs, shipping, care, and more.

items.question: How long does a grow log last?
items.answer: Most grow logs will produce multiple flushes of mushrooms over 2-4 years depending on the species and how well the log is cared for.

items.question: Do I need any special equipment?
items.answer: No special equipment is needed. A spray bottle for misting and a shaded spot are all you need to get started.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: We ship via Royal Mail. Standard delivery is 2-3 working days within the UK.

items.question: Can I grow mushrooms indoors?
items.answer: Yes! Most of our grow logs work well indoors. Just find a cool, shaded spot away from direct sunlight and radiators.

items.question: What species do you offer?
items.answer: We currently offer Shiitake, Oyster, and Lions Mane grow logs. Check our shop for the latest availability.

items.question: My grow log has not produced any mushrooms yet. What should I do?
items.answer: Make sure the log is being kept moist and is in a cool, shaded location. Some logs take a few weeks to start producing. If it has been more than 4 weeks, try soaking the log in cold water overnight to trigger a flush.
